headline: 6 stories worth your time — mostly tools & launches. Start with: Zoho Recruit Automates Small Business Hiring

items.title: Zoho Recruit Automates Small Business Hiring
items.summary: Zoho Recruit helps small businesses automate hiring with AI-powered job descriptions, candidate screening, resume scoring, interviews, and more.
items.whyItMatters: Written for your side of the market rather than for enterprise buyers. Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Pick the single most repetitive task in your week and see whether this covers it end to end.
